name: Lamplight
description:
RGB keyboard lighting for laptops and devices with Windows Dynamic Lighting (HID LampArray), such as ASUS Vivobook S models: effects, colors, brightness and speed, in sync with the Fn backlight keys.

After installing, open the Lighting tile and choose "Set up keyboard access" once (asks for your password). Needs Python 3 with PyGObject, which GNOME systems normally have. The optional lamplight package adds a settings app and color calibration: https://github.com/egeisik35/lamplight
